title: The Exam That Would Not Start
dream: I was in my old school, walking down a corridor towards an exam. Every door opened into the same classroom, and a clock insisted I was late.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt anxious and under pressure.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
Does the approaching exam remind you of a current responsibility?
followUps.answer: I have a deadline soon and worry about being prepared.

title: The Paper Classroom
dream: I entered a school through a paper door and found an exam in a corridor. The clock ran backwards, but I felt curious and began rearranging the questions.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt curious rather than frightened.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What felt different about being able to change the questions?
followUps.answer: It felt like I had control instead of just pressure.

title: The Unfair Exam
dream: At school I waited outside an exam in a corridor. A clock skipped an hour and the door shut before I could enter. I argued that the rules were unfair.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt angry and frustrated.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What stood out about the rules in this situation?
followUps.answer: I was upset that my effort did not seem to matter.

title: The House in the Tide
dream: My childhood house stood in shallow water beside the ocean. A flood rose slowly around it while I packed things I wanted to keep.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt sad and full of longing.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What did you most want to keep?
followUps.answer: Small reminders of childhood and the feeling of home.

title: The Quiet Floating House
dream: I returned to the same house on the ocean. The flood had settled into clear water, and I sat on the roof feeling safe as it drifted gently.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt peaceful and content.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What made this version feel safe?
followUps.answer: There was no hurry. I could let change happen without resisting it.

title: The House Below the Ocean
dream: I saw a house beneath the ocean through clear water. The flood was suspended in place, and I could not decide whether the house was sinking or rising.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt confused and uncertain.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What was it like not knowing which direction things were moving?
followUps.answer: It reminded me of a transition where I cannot yet tell whether I am making progress.

title: A Flight Above the Clouds
dream: I was flying through a violet sky above the clouds. The moon unfolded like a map and the stars became destinations I could choose.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt amazed and full of wonder.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What appealed to you about choosing a destination?
followUps.answer: Exploration and discovery felt possible without having a plan.

title: The Familiar Flight
dream: I was flying through the same sky and clouds again. The moon was close enough to touch and the stars arranged themselves into a route I recognised.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt joyful and free.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
How did recognising the route change the experience?
followUps.answer: I felt confident about the journey instead of needing to know every step.

title: The Silver Smile
dream: My teeth became tiny silver bells. In a mirror they rang whenever I smiled, but the reflection smiled a moment before I did.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt bewildered and amused.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What caught your attention most?
followUps.answer: The delay felt backwards. I was interested rather than upset.

title: The Ember Sculpture
dream: A statue made of fire stood perfectly still. Its flames changed colour whenever I hummed, and I listened quietly until the sculpture faded.

followUps.question: How did you feel during the dream?
followUps.answer: I felt calm and quietly happy.

followUps.question: How intense did it feel, from 1 to 10?
What did you enjoy about that moment?
followUps.answer: I liked being able to watch without needing to fix or achieve anything.
